verdict.rationale: Polar is a billing/payments platform; evidence shows it exposes an MCP server so external AI agents can query/act on data, and dashboards show real-time margin/usage metrics, but there is no evidence of Polar itself generating AI-driven insights, suggestions, or analysis inside its own product UI. missing for 10: any in-product AI-generated insights, recommendations, or anomaly/trend analysis surfaced natively within Polar's dashboard.
